d: Bihar ke navada jile se kanun-vyavastha aur insaniyat ko sharmasar kar dene vali ek sanasnikhej vardat samne aaee hai. jile ke siradla thana kshetr antargat dhab ganv men mamuli vivad ke bad aakroshit graminon ne kanun hath men lete hue ek yuvak ko khaderkar pakra aur bijli ke khanbhe se rassi dvara bandhkar uski jamkar pitaee kar di.
